Maria Chen: FYI — staging push for 1.23.0 got blocked by a cosign provenance annotation mismatch on eu-ecr (repo: redwood/runtime:1.23.0). DeployBot skipped the publish step.
Alex B.: Can you paste the DeployBot log id? or run the status command?
DeployBot: automated: publish aborted — provenance-check failed: missing KMS-stamp in attestation. log_id=rbw-1765.
James K: I saw this pattern last week when KMS had a transient HA blip in eu-west-1 (~45s). Quick options: (A) retag with prior digest and push (B) pin canary to prev digest and hold full release (C) re-run attest after infra fixes.
Olivia R.: Leaning B — keep canary traffic on the previous digest so we don't regress canary metrics, hold full rollout. We should update release notes to mention a pinned-fallback + manual re-publish. @Terry (oncall) can you extend the change window? :lock:
Terry (oncall): :thumbsup: I can extend by 30m and open an incident INC-1765 for KMS. Please add the fallback steps here.
Maria Chen: Fallback snippet I use when we need to pin to a previous digest:
```bash
# fetch manifest for previous digest and retag to the release tag
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234 | jq -r .images[0].imageManifest > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-tag 1.23.0 --image-manifest file://manifest.json
# re-upload attestation if available (manual step)
cosign upload-attestation --artifact redwood/runtime:1.23.0 --attestation-file attestation.json
```
We will only apply this for canary and not promote to prod until attest passes.
Alex B.: I'll draft the release notes blurb and push to the release branch. Suggested text: "Release paused: provenance attestation mismatch detected in EU region; canary pinned to previous digest. Full rollout pending attestation re-run — see INC-1765."
DeployBot: info: Canary route pinned to digest sha256:abcd1234 for release 1.23.0. Promotes disabled until manual approval.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll coordinate with infra to re-run attest once KMS is healthy. Logging decision in the release PR and adding the snippet to the ops runbook. :memo:
